experiment: CG-MICROWAVE-FIT R1 — LG LMHM2237 OTR microwave fit observation against all frozen canonical contracts. Evidence classification only — no microwave.json, no canonical mutation, no overlay compounding.

r1DecisionGate.question: Which microwave functional behaviors are independently diagnosable on LMHM2237, and do any map to an existing frozen contract without contamination?
r1DecisionGate.notAsked: Does LG microwave belong in range_oven because both have doors and thermal devices?
r1DecisionGate.keyDistinction: Unfamiliar component name ≠ new canonical function. Repeated functional behavior + absent host in frozen contracts + (pending R2) cross-manufacturer recurrence → possible new canonical domain.

procedureObservations.title: §6-3: PCB Thermistor (F-1 / F-2)
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Service-test entry (Defrost weight/time 2s → TEST) surfaces F-1 short / F-2 open on cabinet PCB thermistor; routes to thermistor or PCB replacement.
procedureObservations.sequencing: Self-test before component condemnation; beep on fault entry per extraction doc.
procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: control_and_sensing — cavity/cabinet thermal feedback for control board

procedureObservations.title: §6-3: Humidity Sensor (F-4)
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Service test surfaces F-4 humidity sensor fault; independent diagnostic path from thermistor and HV chain.
procedureObservations.sequencing: Paired with thermistor in §6-3 self diagnosis.
procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: control_and_sensing — moisture feedback for sensor-cook modes

procedureObservations.title: §9-2: Door Interlock Switches
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Three-switch interlock chain with distinct door-open vs door-closed states: primary COM–NO, secondary COM–NO, monitor COM–NC. Latch adjustment path §9-1 before switch replacement.
procedureObservations.sequencing: Primary open → primary closed → secondary open → secondary closed → monitor open → monitor closed; HV discharge prerequisite on every HV-adjacent path.

measurements.logic: Open with door open (primary/secondary); closed with door shut; monitor NC closed with door open, open with door shut

procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: door_interlock_chain — not equivalent to single oven_door_switch authorization

procedureObservations.title: §6-4: No Display / Dead Unit
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Dead-unit tree: key response → PCB connectors → cord L/N continuity → line fuse → noise filter coils L(1)–L(2) and N(1)–N(2).
procedureObservations.sequencing: UI responsiveness before fuse condemnation; noise filter after line fuse.

procedureObservations.title: §6-4: No Heat / No Cook
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Orchestrates no-heat path: door cycle ×3 → thermal cutout TAB1–TAB2 → latch continuity → Relay 2 >8 V during EZ-ON → delegate to §10 HV component tests.
procedureObservations.sequencing: Door/interlock before thermal cutout before control relay before HV cascade.
decisionLogic: Relay 2 voltage across D35 > 8 V during EZ-ON start required before HV branch
Explicit handoff to transformer, capacitor, diode, magnetron, HV fuse (§10)
procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: no-heat complaint routing across interlock → thermal → control relay → hv_generation

procedureObservations.title: §10: High-Voltage Transformer
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: HV transformer primary 0.2–0.5 Ω; secondary 50–120 Ω; filament winding ~0 Ω separate; windings to ground infinite (Rx1000).
procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: hv_generation — no analogue in any frozen canonical heat_circuit

procedureObservations.title: §10: High-Voltage Capacitor
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Terminal-to-terminal leakage check Rx1000: momentarily infinite then ~10 MΩ; terminal-to-case infinite.

measurements.note: leakage/resistance behavior specified in procedure; capacitance µF in wizard knowledge

procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: hv_generation — paired with magnetron/diode in RF excitation path

procedureObservations.title: §10: High-Voltage Diode
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Polarity-dependent HV diode check — short in both directions fails; open both directions fails.

procedureObservations.title: §10: Magnetron
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Filament < 1 Ω (Rx1); filament to chassis infinite (Rx1000). Outcome requires waveguide/gasket check and leakage test after replacement.

procedureObservations.title: §10: High-Voltage Fuse
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: HV fuse continuity under 10 Ω; blown fuse triggers inspect door switches and HV short paths before replace.
procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: hv_generation protection — distinct from line fuse in power_supply layer

procedureObservations.title: §6-4: Keypad Failure
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Touch/key response diagnostic when display or input fails independently of heat path.

procedureObservations.title: §10: Turntable Motor
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Turntable motor 2.5–3.5 kΩ; if motor OK check door latch and RY1 relay on PCB.
procedureObservations.candidateFunctionalMapping: mechanical_drive — no host in cooking heat contracts

power_supply.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: 120 VAC inlet, line fuse, noise filter coils, cord continuity — prerequisite for all other domains.

range_oven.rationale: Same mains prerequisite role; microwave adds noise-filter coil pair diagnostic not present in range_oven contract — implementation detail, not reason to merge ontologies.

control_board.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Main PCB orchestrates relay paths (Relay 2 HV enable), self-test, thermistor/humidity fault routing.

range_oven.rationale: Control orchestration role analogous, but microwave PCB commands HV relay/magnetron path — merging would import HV semantics into locked range contract.

user_interface.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Keypad/touch input, display, service-mode entry (Defrost 2s → TEST).

range_oven.rationale: HMI/service-mode entry role similar; does not justify absorbing HV or interlock domains into range_oven.

door_interlock_chain.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Independently diagnosable three-switch chain including monitor NC logic tied to HV safety — sequential §9-2 tests with latch adjustment.

range_oven.rationale: Range oven door switch is oven authorization/latch — not a three-switch HV monitor chain. Superficial 'door switch' label hides different functional safety behavior.

french_door_refrigerator.rationale: Door switch for light/alarm — no HV interlock chain.

dishwasher.rationale: Door interlock for tub fill — different safety semantics.

vented_dryer.rationale: Door/belt switch — no HV monitor chain.

door_interlock_chain.notEquivalentBecause: Repeated functional behavior (monitor switch NC with door open) is independently tested and routed — not reducible to single COM–NO door switch.

thermal_protection.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Thermal cutout TAB1–TAB2 continuity on no-heat path; PCB thermistor F-1/F-2 on self-test — two distinct thermal behaviors.

range_oven.rationale: Range thermal_protection covers oven thermal fuse/cutoff — not PCB cabinet thermistor + HV thermal cutout sequencing on microwave no-heat tree.

hv_generation.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Independently sequenced HV cascade: enable relay → transformer → capacitor → diode → magnetron → HV fuse; discharge safety on every touch.

range_oven.rationale: Oven heat uses resistive/gas/ignition instance scopes — no magnetron/HV rectification domain.

french_door_refrigerator.rationale: Sealed-system compressor — not HV RF generation.

vented_dryer.rationale: Resistive/gas vented heat — no HV RF.

hv_generation.divergenceSignal: preliminary_R1 — repeated independent diagnostic sequencing across six procedures; absent from all frozen contracts

rf_cavity.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Waveguide/gasket/arcing path referenced at magnetron replacement; turntable for field uniformity.

range_oven.rationale: range_oven deferred oven_cavity — no RF waveguide semantics.

rf_cavity.divergenceSignal: preliminary_R1 — arcing/waveguide is functional complaint route in extraction doc

control_and_sensing.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Humidity sensor F-4 and PCB thermistor F-1/F-2 as independent sensor faults on self-test.

range_oven.rationale: Oven RTD is cavity temperature for bake — not humidity sensor or cabinet PCB thermistor fault family.

french_door_refrigerator.rationale: Multiple compartment sensors — may share 'sensor fault code' pattern but not humidity-for-cook; defer without forcing fit.

vented_dryer.rationale: Moisture sensor is dryness termination — different function.

ventilation_otr.microwaveFunctionalBehavior: Vent path referenced on thermal cutout replacement; no dedicated vent-motor procedure in R1 catalog.

range_oven.rationale: OTR vent fan must not map to surface_heating_system — insufficient R1 procedure evidence.

rangeOvenContaminationAssessment.verdict: Microwave cannot merge into range_oven without contaminating locked contract
contaminationRisks: thermal_protection → oven thermal fuse semantics only
